rationale: This mutation eliminates the $9,500 cash gap by scaling contiguous land to 28-30 plots synchronized with 10-11 hands (~2.7 plots/hand) through a Day 15 land freeze, fully utilizing workforce capacity to capture compounding Strawberry flushes without worker idle time. It resolves harvest delays and shed starvation by overhauling micro-dispatch with pre-harvest well refills for zero-delay in-situ watering and backpack-gated shed drop-offs (>=75% capacity), unlocking rapid town shop arbitrage (2.0x-3.5x) and raising the liquidation trigger to surplus >= 8 with defended >=0.82x mature floors to preserve crop margins. Finally, it monetizes endgame acreage with a hyper-fertilized Carrot backfill on vacant plots between Days 22-26 and advances consolidated terminal clearance to step 696 to prevent order congestion under the 10-order engine cap.
